description: This file contains unit tests for a max heap data structure used in activation repartitioning algorithms within the Orleans framework. It defines a test class 'MaxHeapTests' and a nested class 'MyHeapElement' used to test heap operations and properties.

classes.name: MaxHeapTests
classes.description: Contains unit tests for the max heap data structure.

classes.name: MyHeapElement
classes.description: A heap element implementation used in testing, with a value, heap index, and comparison logic.

methods.name: HeapPropertyIsMaintained
methods.description: Test method verifying the heap property is maintained during various operations such as insertion, priority update, and removal.
